questions.question:
Rearrange the parts of the sentence in correct order.

As global

P. electricity generation is expected to

Q. significantly to maintain its current share of the mix

R. double over the next three decades, nuclear power

S. generating capacity would need to expand
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 1'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**Let's break down each part:

 
• **P -** This part indicates a specific type of electricity generation - nuclear power.** It is a continuation of the introduction** about global electricity generation given in the initial part of the sentence.
 
• **R -** This part introduces the timeframe for the expected changes - over the next three decades. **It logically follows P **as it continues to provide details about nuclear power.
 
• **S - **This part specifies the necessary action in response to the change in global electricity generation - expansion.** It is the response to the situation introduced in P and R.**
 
• **Q -** This part explains the reason for the action described in S - to maintain the current share of the mix.** It naturally follows S to conclude** the sentence.

Therefore, the** sentence then reads**: *"As global electricity generation is expected to double over the next three decades, nuclear power (P) generating capacity would need to expand (S) significantly to maintain its current share of the mix (Q)."*

questions.question:
Select the correct passive form of the given sentence.

My father fixed the computer easily.

options.text: The computer was fixed by my father easily.
The computer is fixed by my father easily.
The computer was fix by my father easily.
The computer fixed by my father easily.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 1'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the active voice sentence *"My father fixed the computer easily,"* the subject (my father) performs the action of the verb (fixed).
 
• In the passive voice, the object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject and the subject of the active voice sentence becomes the agent introduced by "by".
 
• *"The computer was fixed by my father easily."* - This is the **correct passive form.**
 
• The past simple tense is represented in passive voice with 'was/were' + past participle (fixed).

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is: *'The computer was fixed by my father easily.'*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Now let's explain this in more detail:
 
 
• **"The computer is fixed by my father easily." **- This is the incorrect form. The verb 'is' is used for present simple tense, but the original sentence is in the past simple tense.
 
• **"The computer was fix by my father easily." **- This is incorrect because the past participle of the verb "fix" is "fixed," not "fix".
 
• **"The computer fixed by my father easily." **- This is incorrect. It lacks the auxiliary verb 'was' that is necessary to form the passive voice in the past simple tense.

options.text: such as flower or fruit extracts and oils.

• In the incorrect sentence, the verb** "been"** is used** incorrectly.**

questions.question:
Some parts of a paragraph have been jumbled up, and labelled A, B, C and D. Select the option that gives the correct sequence in which these parts can be rearranged to form a meaningful and grammatically correct paragraph. Carts: carts have two solid wheels.

A. The triangles are distributed in three concentric circles.

B. The wheels are decorated with triangles made of copper.

C. The chassis of the two carts are made of wood and covered with thick copper sheets.

D. The wheels rotated on a fixed axle linked by a shaft to the yoke. The concentric circles start from the hub flange of the wheel.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 4'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The correct sequence of the sentences to form a meaningful and grammatically correct paragraph is **4) DCBA.**
 
• Here's the rationale:
 
• **D. **The wheels rotated on a fixed axle linked by a shaft to the yoke.
 
 
• This **sentence should come first **as it introduces the fact that the carts have wheels, which is a necessary detail before we discuss the wheels' decoration (B), their material (C), and their structure (A).
 
 
 
• **C.** The chassis of the two carts are made of wood and covered with thick copper sheets.
 
 
• This **sentence follows nicely from D**, further describing the construction of the carts and the materials used.
 
 
 
• **B. **The wheels are decorated with triangles made of copper.
 
 
• **After discussing the materials** of the carts, **it's appropriate to move on** to the decoration of the wheels.
 
 
 
• **A. **The triangles are distributed in three concentric circles.
 
 
• Finally,** this sentence goes into more specific detail **about the decoration mentioned in B,** closing the paragraph** nicely by describing how the triangles are arranged.
 
 

Therefore, the **correct sequence** is** DCBA:** *"The wheels rotated on a fixed axle linked by a shaft to the yoke. The chassis of the two carts are made of wood and covered with thick copper sheets. The wheels are decorated with triangles made of copper. The triangles are distributed in three concentric circles."*

questions.question:
Given below are four jumbled sentences. Pick the option that gives their correct order.

P. The Spanish flu, also known as the 1918 flu pandemic, was a deadly pandemic in recent history.

Q. It spread worldwide during the year 1918-1919.

R. The virus infected 500 million people – about a third of the world's population at the time.

S. The death toll was estimated to be at least 50 million worldwide, possibly as high as 100 million this makes it the severest pandemic in human history.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 1'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **correct sequence** of the sentences to form a meaningful and grammatically correct paragraph is **1) PQRS.**
 
• Here's the rationale:
 
• **P. **The Spanish flu, also known as the 1918 flu pandemic, was a deadly pandemic in recent history.
 
 
• **This sentence should come first **as it introduces the subject, which is the Spanish flu.
 
 
 
• **Q. **It spread worldwide during the year 1918-1919.
 
 
• This** sentence logically follows P,** providing information about when and where the Spanish flu spread.
 
 
 
• R. The virus infected 500 million people – about a third of the world's population at the time.
 
 
• After stating when and where the flu spread, this **sentence gives specifics about** how many people were affected, providing additional information about the severity of the Spanish flu.
 
 
 
• **S. **The death toll was estimated to be at least 50 million worldwide, possibly as high as 100 million this makes it the severest pandemic in human history.
 
 
• **Finally, this sentence further underscores** the severity of the Spanish flu by discussing the death toll, which makes it a fitting conclusion to the paragraph.
 
 

Therefore, the **correct sequence** is** PQRS**: *"The Spanish flu, also known as the 1918 flu pandemic, was a deadly pandemic in recent history. It spread worldwide during the year 1918-1919. The virus infected 500 million people – about a third of the world's population at the time. The death toll was estimated to be at least 50 million worldwide, possibly as high as 100 million this makes it the severest pandemic in human history."*

questions.question:
Choose the option that is the correct indirect form of the sentence.

Ravi said, “I may sell this tie.”

options.text: Ravi said that he may sell that tie.
Ravi said that he might sell that tie.
Ravi said that I might sell that tie.
Ravi said that he should sell this tie.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 2'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **correct answer** is 2) *"Ravi said that he might sell that tie."*
 
• When converting direct speech into indirect speech, the tense of the verb usually shifts back.
 
• In this case,** "may"** in direct speech** becomes** **"might" **in indirect speech.
 
• **'This' **will be **changed** to** 'That'.**
 
• **'I' **will be **changed **into** 'He'.**

Therefore, the** correct sentence **is: *'Ravi said that he might sell that tie'.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The other options are incorrect because:
 
 
• **"Ravi said that he may sell that tie.**" This does not correctly backshift the verb "may" to "might".
 
• **"Ravi said that I might sell that tie.**" This incorrectly changes the subject from "he" to "I".
 
• **"Ravi said that he should sell this tie.**" This changes the meaning of the sentence by replacing "may" with "should", and it incorrectly retains "this" instead of changing it to "that".
